steps.label: Hochladen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && a=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -T sears_film3.mp4 -H "Content-Type: video/mp4" -H "If-None-Match: *" "$(tr -d '\n' < vurl_s3.txt)") && b=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -T sears_thumb_a.jpg -H "Content-Type: image/jpeg" -H "If-None-Match: *" "$(tr -d '\n' < turl_s3.txt)") && : > vurl_s3.txt && : > turl_s3.txt && echo "video $a thumb $b" > sr_up3.txt && cat sr_up3.txt && [ "$a" = 200 ] && [ "$b" = 200 ]
